agents.instruction: Prepare a focused kimi_search request for Azerbaijan border-crossing research. Use the incoming azScriptPlan and coordinator context, along with these seed sources: https://bordercrossinghub.com/tsiteli-red-bridge-shikhly-ii-border-crossing/, https://caravanistan.com/border-crossings/azerbaijan/, https://mfa.gov.az/en/news, https://mfa.gov.az/en/category/announcements, https://www.migration.gov.az/en/, https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/azerbaijan, https://en.apa.az/. Cover current status, relevant named crossings, closure/operating conditions, uncertainty, and likely official corroboration. Query focus: current Azerbaijan land border crossing status, including closures, exceptions, disputes, and security; corroborate with official government and travel-advice sources. Return only a JSON object with exactly these keys: text_query (a concise, specific search query incorporating relevant crossing names and recency), include_content (true when returned page content would help verify current operational details; otherwise false), limit (integer 1–20, normally 8), timeout_seconds (integer 1–60, normally 30). Do not return script paths, stdinJSON, crawl instructions, or extra keys.
agents.name: AzerbaijanScriptPlanner

Include returned page content when useful for evidence.
